baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative seeing construction joins the accomplished creation of the heavens and earth to the infinitival revival of the dead.
baseline_models.mechanism: The visible created whole is treated as an accomplished larger act. Recognizing that act licenses an a-fortiori move from origination to restoring life, while the capacity predicate states that the transition is executable.

activation_trace.role: Perception by eye or insight makes the extant cosmos available as evidence rather than as background scenery.
Origination supplies the accomplished act from which the argument to renewed life proceeds.
Life as animate existence names the state into which the dead are to be transferred.
Loss of life supplies the apparently terminal state that the revival clause reverses.
Effective mastery closes the inference by asserting that renewed animation can actually be performed.

changed_reading.before: A bare assertion that God can resurrect.
changed_reading.after: A demand to infer renewed life from an already perceptible and greater act of origination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two creation forms stand beside two capacity forms whose branch range includes measure, limit, and planning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation can be heard as prior measuring as well as bringing into being, while the repeated capacity root can carry both bounded proportion and planned execution. Revival then becomes deliberate reconstitution according to a known design, not an unspecified burst of force.

activation_trace.role: Pre-action measuring lets the first creation function as a designed pattern available for reconstitution.
Measure and limit give the repeated capacity language a proportional as well as a powerful register.
Planning and exact preparation supply the functional route from an existing design to its remaking.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection is imagined only as raw power overcoming death.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection is also measured remaking: the one who designed the first formation can deliberately reconstitute it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated failure and bodily fatigue clause lies between creation and the doubled capacity predicate, which ends with universal scope.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse blocks both inability to find a way through the task and depletion while doing it. Enclosing those negations with repeated capacity language and complete scope presents creative efficacy as unspent after cosmic creation and unrestricted by the identity of its next object.

activation_trace.role: Failure to find or execute the way through an undertaking supplies one limit that the negation removes.
Bodily weariness supplies the depletion model that cosmic creation explicitly does not produce.
Effective mastery on both sides of the revival clause presents capacity as remaining available after prior action.
Complete enclosure extends the final capacity claim across the whole domain.
The maximally general knowable object prevents death from being isolated as an exception.

changed_reading.before: The creator was strong enough once and may be strong enough again.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic creation causes neither procedural failure nor depletion; the remaining capacity encompasses every possible object, including the dead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier repetition of cosmic creation places it under reality-conforming purpose and an appointed limit. That turns the focus resurrection from an optional sequel to creation into the timed completion of a creation whose history was bounded from its outset.

activation_trace.role: Measure, limit, and term make the focus capacity language receptive to a scheduled completion.
Repeated origination carries the same cosmic act into the earlier purpose-and-term frame.
Stable conformity to reality keeps creation from reading as purposeless display.
A fixed temporal endpoint supplies the boundary through which resurrection becomes a due phase.

structural_cues: 46:3 repeats the same heavens-earth creation pair and immediately coordinates purpose with an appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated cosmic creation, reality-conforming purpose, and a fixed term; I infer a term-bound first creation -> resurrection as its completion. A live alternative is that purpose, term, and resurrection remain separate claims joined only at the surah level.

changed_reading.before: The first creation proves only abstract possibility.
changed_reading.after: The first creation is a purposeful, time-bounded process whose promised completion includes bringing the dead to life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier challenge couples an attention-demanding question with an order to show what rival powers created. It sharpens the focus opening from passive looking into an evidence procedure: inspect the world, attempt a rival causal account, and answer for the result.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment lets the focus question demand a considered conclusion from what is seen.
The attention-seeking interrogative turns vision into an accountable request for an answer.
Causing something to be shown adds demonstrability to the earlier challenge.
The demand to identify any rival origination makes causal attribution the test applied by the focus question.

structural_cues: 46:4 sequences consider, show me, and what did they create, turning an interrogative into a test of evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier question-show-creation sequence; I infer that sequence -> a reusable evidentiary procedure in 46:33. A live alternative is simple rhetorical repetition without a formal procedure.

changed_reading.before: They are merely told to notice a large created object.
changed_reading.after: They are required to test causal claims against creation and admit that the same creator can restore the dead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied emergence in 46:17 and the graded, fully paid deeds in 46:19 give the focus revival a destination. Bringing the dead to life is no longer undifferentiated biological restoration; it is emergence into a differentiated settlement whose outputs correspond to prior actions.

activation_trace.role: Return to animate existence supplies the necessary transition into the later settlement.
Actual loss of life makes the contextual emergence more than a change of social status.
Being brought from concealment gives bodily revival the spatial form of emergence.
Stepwise degree differentiates the post-revival outcomes rather than flattening them.
Intentional action supplies the individualized input by which the revived are distinguished.
Completion without deficit makes revival serve exact settlement rather than mere reappearance.

structural_cues: The family skeptic denies being brought out in 46:17; 46:19 then places every person on degrees and connects those degrees to deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied emergence followed by graded and complete recompense; I infer resurrection -> entry into that accounting process. A live alternative is that emergence and recompense are adjacent consequences without defining the function of revival itself.

changed_reading.before: Revival restores an undifferentiated population to life.
changed_reading.after: Revival brings persons out for exact, deed-sensitive differentiation and settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 46:24-26, direct sight misclassifies an apparent rain bearer; the result annihilates the complete local field, and possessed faculties avail nothing under knowing denial. The focus repairs that sequence: reflective seeing must read creation correctly, while the same totality formula that framed destruction is reopened under life-giving capacity.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment distinguishes the focus demand from the failed direct sight in the preceding narrative.
Restored animate life supplies the positive reversal of the narrative's terminal destruction.
Effective mastery reopens a field that the prior annihilation appeared to close.
Direct visual perception supplies the true but insufficient first step in the mistaken cloud reading.
Expected water from sky supplies the life-bearing interpretation that the observers wrongly assign to the visible sign.
Extirpating destruction flips the expected life-bearing arrival into comprehensive loss.
Complete enclosure gives the destruction phrase the same totalizing reach later attached to capacity.
The general object term creates a direct scope echo between annihilation and the focus claim.
Denial despite knowledge explains why available perception fails to become the recognition demanded in the focus.

structural_cues: 46:24-26 sequences sight, a life-bearing misclassification, comprehensive destruction, visible residue, ineffective faculties, and denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the failed sight-to-rain inference, comprehensive destruction, and knowing denial; I infer that negative sequence -> 46:33 as both epistemic correction and material reversal. A live alternative is that the narrative only warns while the focus independently states generic omnipotence.

changed_reading.before: Seeing creation straightforwardly yields a neutral proof of resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The verse corrects a demonstrated failure of interpretation and reverses the prior totality of destruction into a totality still open to renewed life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after destroyed settlements, the signs are repeatedly oriented toward return. This permits two coexisting returns inside the focus revival: bodies return from death, while responsive readers turn back before destruction. The physical claim supplies urgency to the ethical motion without reducing one to the other.

activation_trace.role: Animate life anchors one return as literal restoration rather than metaphor alone.
Actual death supplies the boundary crossed by bodily return.
Falling into annihilation supplies the historical endpoint from which return becomes urgent.
Going back to a former state supplies the shared motion linking repentance and restored life.

structural_cues: 46:27 places destroyed communities, repeatedly presented signs, and hoped-for return in one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies annihilation followed by signs aimed at return; I infer ethical return as a present analogue of bodily return. A live alternative is that the contextual return means repentance only and contributes urgency but no internal model of resurrection.

changed_reading.before: Revival concerns only a future bodily event.
changed_reading.after: Future bodily return and present ethical return become parallel but non-identical reversals of a movement toward annihilation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding verse twice negates escape and names human inability; the focus then negates divine inability and fatigue before affirming effective mastery twice. The adjacency creates an agency asymmetry: creatures cannot outrun the promised event, while prior creation cannot deplete or frustrate its agent.

activation_trace.role: Inability to find a way through an undertaking is explicitly removed from the creator's side of the contrast.
Fatigue is likewise removed, so the contrast concerns both failure and depletion.
Effective mastery states the positive divine side after the two removed limits.
Repeated state-negation builds the immediate grammatical frame for denying creaturely escape.
Weakness and shortfall identify the inability assigned to the non-responding creature.
Failure to escape pursuit specifies that creaturely inability as non-evasion of the coming event.

structural_cues: 46:32 and 46:33 are adjacent negative constructions: the first denies escape, and the second denies fatigue before asking about capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent negations of creaturely escape and divine fatigue plus opposing inability/capacity ranges; I infer adjacency -> a deliberate agency contrast. A live alternative is that 46:32 concerns judgment while 46:33 independently proves resurrection, with contrast only rhetorical.

changed_reading.before: The focus reassures that resurrection is within divine ability.
changed_reading.after: It completes an asymmetry: humans cannot evade the event, whereas no difficulty or prior exertion can impede the one who enacts it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus negative question receives an immediate affirmative answer; the next verse repeats the negative-question and affirmative-answer structure at exposure, then moves to experienced consequence. The first answer therefore reads as an offered confession before it becomes an unavoidable verdict.

activation_trace.role: Reflective recognition supplies the voluntary form of the answer requested in the focus.
Effective mastery is the proposition to which the first affirmative answer assents.
A second negative state-question reproduces the focus's answer-demanding form.
Reality that defeats denial supplies the proposition conceded at the later exposure.
Experiential testing turns belated verbal recognition into encountered consequence.

structural_cues: 46:33 and 46:34 repeat the same negative-question and affirmative-answer hinge, but only the second occurs at exposure and is followed by consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated question-answer syntax and the move to experienced consequence; I infer the first answer -> a presently available version of the later compelled verdict. A live alternative is emphatic sound-patterning without a staged confession mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The affirmative particle simply closes a logical proof.
changed_reading.after: It rehearses now the recognition that deniers will voice when resurrection has become an experienced verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command to restrain impatience, the appointed promise, and the later collapse of perceived duration prevent capacity from being equated with haste. The focus's measured and unwearied power can sustain a schedule whose long wait appears as an hour once the promised event is seen.

activation_trace.role: Measure and term allow capacity to include exact timing rather than immediate execution alone.
Negated weariness makes delay compatible with sustained efficacy rather than fatigue.
Restraint from panic or impatience supplies the human posture required during the interval.
Eventual perception marks the point at which promised time is retrospectively compressed.
A promise fixed to a time supplies the schedule whose fulfillment is certain but not hurried.
Remaining for a span supplies the duration later judged to have been only momentary.

structural_cues: 46:35 prohibits haste, then makes the interval before the seen promise resemble only an hour of a day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patience, non-haste, an appointed promise, eventual seeing, and compressed remembered duration; I infer sovereign capacity -> exact timing rather than speed. A live alternative is that the patience command governs only prophetic conduct and does not modify the focus model of power.

changed_reading.before: If resurrection is possible, capacity should imply immediate execution.
changed_reading.after: Unwearied capacity includes command of timing: it can wait without weakening and make the completed interval appear brief.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant secondary mapping for the seeing root and because the dead in the focus most directly denotes persons. It remains anchored by that supplied split inventory, the explicit heavens-earth frame, the earth-life and dead-land branches, and 46:24's seen but misread rain expectation. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological and imagistic resonance, never as a replacement gloss for the resurrection claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The seeing verb's secondary mapped inventory, the heavens, and the life/death pair permit a rain-on-dead-land image beneath the direct human-resurrection reading.

activation_trace.role: The secondary mapping contributes a heavy rain-cloud image as a latent underside of the seeing verb.
What is overhead includes sky, cloud, and rain, spatially housing the ecological image.
Rain and vegetation literally supply an earth-revival pathway alongside animate resurrection.
Uncultivated dead land supplies the ecological patient capable of becoming productive again.
Actual sight anchors the contextual cloud scene that activates the secondary focus mapping.
Expected descending water supplies the familiar life-bearing outcome that the narrative withholds.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns only the reanimation of human corpses.
changed_reading.after: Human resurrection remains primary, but it carries a contained ecological shadow: heavenly water reviving dead earth, made unstable by the preceding false-rain sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ordinary creation and human death are branch-distant from worn fabric and general stilling. It remains anchored in the repeated creation root, the explicit denial of fatigue, and the focus life/death reversal. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy about decay and non-depletion, not a lexical claim that creation here means a worn garment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Repeated creation, negated fatigue, and revival allow a contrast between a created order that wears or falls still and an agent whose capacity does not wear out.

activation_trace.role: A fabric worn smooth by use supplies the material model of created forms undergoing decay.
Bodily fatigue supplies the wear that the verse denies of the creative agent.
Stilling, sleep, and material wear broaden death into a model of arrested or decayed function.
Effective mastery supplies the unchanged agency capable of reactivating what has worn or gone still.

changed_reading.before: Created things decay, and resurrection is a separate display of force.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also stage an anti-depletion contrast: creation may wear and fall still, but creative capacity does not wear with it and can reactivate it.

strongest_changes: Seeing became an accountable act of causal judgment, especially after the surah demonstrates direct sight producing a disastrous misreading.
Resurrection became the timed completion of purposeful creation and the entry into exact, deed-sensitive recompense.
The comprehensive destruction of 46:25 was reversed by the focus's equally comprehensive but life-giving capacity.
The adjacent inability contrast and repeated affirmative answer made 46:33 both an agency asymmetry and an offered verdict before compulsory recognition.
summary.what_was_special: The focus gathered widely separated mechanisms into one hinge: evidence, measured making, non-depletion, reversal after annihilation, exact accounting, and controlled timing. The packet's secondary seeing-to-rain-cloud mapping also preserved an ecological resonance that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The measured-remaking model may be lexical resonance between creation and capacity rather than a causal account intended by the construction.
The relation between ethical return in 46:27 and bodily return in 46:33 may be analogy only, not a shared mechanism.
The rain-cloud and material-wear outliers remain form-distant and should not displace the direct human-resurrection reading.
